title: The Dog Night, 2003 (unprinted)
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
arc: The Unprinted Year / The Dog Night
logline: Four years. Wordless. Nobody printed it. He went anyway.

panels.composition: The dumpster. The bulb. WOOD and BARNABY. The dog is four; he sits without being asked.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog behind a bowling alley at night before a rusted dumpster under a bare bulb, the dog sitting without being asked, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The rope loop on the chain-link. Still there. Frayed to almost nothing.

image.prompt: close-up of a frayed loop of rope on a chain-link fence under a bare bulb, no words

panels.composition: Wood's hand on the dog's head.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man's hand resting on a small dog's head at night, no words

panels.composition: Walking away. The sign. All lit. Nobody printed this.

image.prompt: a young man and a dog walking away under a fully lit bowling-alley neon sign, black and white, no words
